newsitem.title: ESTONIA: STATE BUDGET COLLECTS 47.68 PCT IN H1.
newsitem.headline: STATE BUDGET COLLECTS 47.68 PCT IN H1.

text.p: Estonia's state budget had collected 5.966 billion kroons or 47.68 percent of its yearly plan as of the end of June according to preliminary data, the country's finance ministry said on Tuesday.
Revenue in June reached 1.276 billion kroons or 10.2 percent of the yearly plan, the ministry added in a statement.
Budget expenditures amounted to 5.932 billion kroons or 47.41 percent of the 1997 plan during the first half of the year.
During the first half of the year in 1996, revenues amounted to 44.52 percent of the yearly plan.
